articles.title: Space Force activates special operations component command in Tampa
articles.summary: U.S. Space Forces Special Operations Command, or SPACEFOR-SOC, formally activated today as the newest service component of U.S. Special Operations Command. Headquartered at MacDill Air Force Base, SPACEFOR-SOC organizes and presents specialized forces – known as SOF Guardians – to Theater Special Operations Commands and Joint Task Forces worldwide.
